text:
The sea
sonríe to lo far.
Teeth of foam,
lips of sky.


¿What vendes, oh young turbia
with the senos to the air?


Vendo, sir, the water
of the mares.


¿What you carry, oh black young,
mezclado with your blood?


I carry, sir, the water
of the mares.


Those tears salobres
¿of dónde vienen, mother?


Lloro, sir, the water
of the mares.


Heart, and this bitterness
seria, ¿of dónde nace?


¡Bitter mucho the water
of the mares!


The sea
sonríe to lo far.
Teeth of foam,
lips of sky.

translation.title: The balada of the water of the sea
